bug_fixes: Repair the root GitHub Actions APK workflow with a stable Ubuntu runner, current Node 24 actions, and direct Android SDK provisioning.
Restore the official Gradle 9.8.2 wrapper with distribution checksum verification and executable launcher permissions.
Build and verify the universal GMS debug APK, publish its checksum, and expose actionable failure diagnostics alongside full build logs.
Restore missing TV banner and Quick Settings branding resources required by the Android manifest, reusing the existing Vybora mark.
Preserve multiple Gradle failure summaries without API annotation truncation and validate branding resource references with regression tests.
Recover omitted binary UI images, legacy launcher foregrounds, and fonts with verified upstream provenance; preserve Vybora primary branding and package all font licenses.
Use official open-licensed Google Sans Flex instead of the restricted upstream binary and fail fast on missing XML/Kotlin resource references before APK compilation.
Fix missing Compose imports on the Vybora About screen and decouple markdown changelog parsing from the removed OTA updater package.
